ns2:course.label: Sexualities and Education
ns2:course.description: Examines policy, curricula, and research on sexuality in education, including the resurgence of virginity and chastity, HIV/AIDS education, education for pregnant teens, sexual orientation and gender identity-related non-discrimination policies and speech codes in public schools, queer youth, and the relationship among sexuality, race, class, disability, and gender. Considers the term "education" broadly, examining school policies, public heal education, and the educational projects of political and social movements. Readings concentrate on a U.S. context, though AIDS and sex education information from international sources will also be included. Same as GWS 545.
